remove_configuration_yaml.title: {integration_title} was imported from configuration.yaml
remove_configuration_yaml.description:
The settings of {integration_title} were imported from configuration.yaml into a config entry, including prefix, rename, rename_entity and the name formats, so your entity IDs stay the same.

Check the integration, then remove the {domain} section from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant to remove this message. Containers and conditions can be changed with Reconfigure, names per entity or device in the UI.
